CBI finds no evidence against NEET-UG paper leak suspect

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has stated that it has found no evidence to implicate Sanjeev Mukhiya, identified as a main suspect in the 2024 NEET-UG paper leak case. This development comes as investigations into the alleged irregularities in the medical entrance exam continue. The CBI's finding suggests a potential shift in the focus of the investigation regarding the leak's origins.
